review_type: fresh-context static adversarial review; same inherited model, not independent model-family cryptographic validation

findings.finding: Pending cross-key references survived after identity arrival, causing summary-hash divergence.
findings.fix: Validate all proofs first; remove every pending reference to arriving identity, suppress only same-key write.

findings.finding: Invalid later replacement proof could partially mutate state/root.
findings.fix: Prevalidate replacement proofs before summary mutation; commit root after summary success.

findings.finding: Fixed rendered state does not bound live identity count; stale member and pending reference evidence can grow.
findings.fix: Added concurrent-identical and unseen-reference workloads, member-lag axis, comparable decode/render timings, explicit provider cost and proof sizes.

production_review: Not performed; experimental code is not integrated into production runtime.
follow_up: Reviewer confirmed cross-key convergence and rejection atomicity fixes; no further concrete counterexample within stated fold-only scope. Static review only; tests and measurements run by implementing session.
